LPT: For new runners. Buy 2 pairs of runners
Well don't buy runners then, I can only assume you're a fattie that has come here to troll.

While this is a really good tip, I feel that it is not actually relevant for the C25K demographic.

If you run a lot, maybe distances of 10-15km or more, or you run on consecutive days, having two pairs of running shoes will let them recover* better between runs, making them last longer.

If you're just starting out and not even breaking 15k per week, one pair is just fine.

Something I think is much more important is getting an actual professional to find the correct shoes for you. You may have to live with a colour you don't like and it will definitely be more expensive than getting something from the bargain bin at Wal-Mart, but it makes a world of difference.

  • (EDIT) basically, the fibers stretch and the sole gets compressed, and they need time to recover. Also, when you need new shoes, it's a good idea to overlap their use with your old shoes, to avoid injury from suddenly changing the foot support.

Good point. But a lot of C25Kers will become more regular runners so its good idea to remember. I couldn't agree with you more about getting professionally fitted runners. My foot is shaped in a bit strangely and I can never get the fashionable shoes but they sure are comfortable.
